title: デビュー戦の後に・黎明

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond finishes her debut race with an excellent performance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back in the waiting area, she celebrates her debut with extraordinary excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way back to the academy, Satono Diamond tells me about the Satono family jinx, which prevents them from winning G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she also declares her intention to break said jinx.
